titulo.es: WHO and the Netherlands renew their partnership on climate change and health
titulo.en: WHO and the Netherlands renew their partnership on climate change and health

sintesis.es: The World Health Organization (WHO) and the Kingdom of the Netherlands have renewed their strategic partnership in addressing the growing impacts of climate change on global health. The Netherlands is providing a new allocation of €500 000 for 2024 to WHO, reinforcing its commitment to climate resilience and sustainable healthcare systems worldwide. This allocation supports WHO’s ongoing efforts to strengthen the Alliance for Transformative Action on Climate and Health Secretariat and advance climate change and health programmes globally.

titulo.es: “No fue algo impulsivo”: Ariana Grande anuncia una pausa en su carrera tras años bajo escrutinio público
titulo.en: Ariana Grande takes a break amid intense public scrutiny and focus on body image

sintesis.es: Después de meses de especulaciones sobre su estado de salud y de una intensa exposición mediática, la cantante estadounidense Ariana Grande confirmó que se alejará temporalmente de la vida pública cuando concluya su gira Eternal Sunshine Tour. La intérprete aseguró que la decisión no responde a una reacción impulsiva, sino a un plan meditado desde hace tiempo para proteger su bienestar, mientras busca cerrar una de las etapas más exitosas de su carrera "con salud y felicidad".
sintesis.en: Ariana Grande spoke directly to her fans at a Chicago concert on Monday about her decision to step back from the public eye. Over the weekend, a representative for Grande, 33, released a statement saying that "Ariana will be taking a step back from visibility after she completes the Eternal Sunshine Tour." Scrutiny of Grande has intensified in recent weeks, fuelled by public discussion of Grande’s physical appearance and overall health.

titulo.es: Nine Lives, the feral cat that terrorised New Zealand’s rare ducks, is caught after three years
titulo.en: Nine Lives, the feral cat that terrorised New Zealand’s rare ducks, is caught after three years

sintesis.es: Large tabby cat that wiped out dozens of rare pāteke, or brown teal, has been killed after eluding trappers with its ‘very erratic’ behaviour A notorious feral cat given the name “Nine Lives” because it eluded trappers for three years has been caught and killed in New Zealand, ending its devastating rampage against one of the country’s rare duck populations. The cat, a large grey tabby, is estimated to have killed dozens of New Zealand’s rarest mainland duck – or 1% of its population – plus a host of kiwi chicks, native geckos and other native wildlife during the three years it was known to be roaming the Purerua peninsula, near the top of the North Island. Continue reading...
